body:
"""The chunk's bar: the 0.3.0 Epoch 6 audit's size and complexity recipe (sum_sizes_cx.py), read at the tree.

usage: python3 bars.py
Population: every tracked .rs file plus untracked ones not ignored (git ls-files -co --exclude-standard).
A file is oversize past 800 tokei code lines; a function is over the ceiling past cognitive 15
(rust-code-analysis-cli, every `function` space, keyed on the file's full path).
Class line: a file standing in upstream/main at 547d7514b (the 2026-11-19 sync's merge base, pinned by sha) is upstream-authored, any other is ours.
PASS when no file of ours reads over 800 but the seven integration-test targets this chunk leaves for a later entry
(LEFT), and no function in a file of ours reads over 15.
Prints the readings, the class counts, and last `bars: PASS` or `bars: FAIL`.
"""
import collections, json, subprocess, sys

LEFT = {
    'tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_requirement_sweep.rs', 'tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_popup.rs',
    'tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs', 'tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_error_text.rs',
    'tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_mcp_tools.rs', 'tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_interaction.rs',
    'examples/seven_guis/tests/cli_commands.rs',
}


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout

files = sorted({f for f in git('ls-files', '-co', '--exclude-standard', '*.rs').split()})
upstream = set(git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', '547d7514ba2adb357d41d5e4655a63ddd5cdc5ec').split())
cls = lambda f: 'upstream' if f in upstream else 'ours'

tok = json.loads(subprocess.run(['tokei', '--output', 'json', '--files', *files], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                check=True).stdout)
code = {}
for r in tok['Rust']['reports']:
    n = r['name'].replace('\\', '/')
    code[n[2:] if n.startswith('./') else n] = r['stats']['code']

fns = []
for f in files:
    out = subprocess.run(['rust-code-analysis-cli', '-m', '-O', 'json', '-p', f], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if out.returncode != 0 or not out.stdout.strip():
        continue
    stack = [json.loads(out.stdout)]
    while stack:
        s = stack.pop()
        if s['kind'] == 'function':
            fns.append((f, s['start_line'], s['name'], s['metrics']['cognitive']['sum']))
        stack.extend(s.get('spaces', []))

over_files = sorted(((f, n) for f, n in code.items() if n > 800), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
over_fns = sorted((x for x in fns if x[3] > 15), key=lambda x: (-x[3], x[0], x[1]))
fc = collections.Counter(cls(f) for f, _ in over_files)
gc = collections.Counter(cls(x[0]) for x in over_fns)
print(f'population: {len(files)} files · {len(fns)} functions')
print(f'files over 800: {len(over_files)} · ours {fc["ours"]} · upstream {fc["upstream"]}')
for f, n in over_files:
    if cls(f) == 'ours':
        print(f'  ours {n} {f}')
print(f'functions over 15: {len(over_fns)} · ours {gc["ours"]} · upstream {gc["upstream"]}')
for f, line, name, cog in over_fns:
    if cls(f) == 'ours':
        print(f'  ours {cog:g} {name} {f}:{line}')
ours_over = {f for f, _ in over_files if cls(f) == 'ours'}
beyond = sorted(ours_over - LEFT)
print(f'ours over 800 outside the seven left for a later entry: {len(beyond)}')
print('bars: PASS' if not beyond and gc['ours'] == 0 else 'bars: FAIL')

body:
"""A2/A3 at HEAD by the 0.3.0 Epoch 6 audit's recipe (sum_sizes_cx.py), population = every tracked .rs file.

Each over-800 file and over-ceiling function is classed OURS (absent from upstream/main) or UPSTREAM (present there).
Writes measure-head.json beside this script.
"""
import json, math, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, collections

SP = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(SP, '..', '..', '..', '..', '..'))
os.chdir(ROOT)
head = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
files = subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-files', '*.rs'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.split()
up = set(subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', 'upstream/main'], capture_output=True, text=True,
                        check=True).stdout.split())
upsha = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'upstream/main'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()


def cls(f):
    return 'upstream' if f in up else 'ours'


lst = os.path.join(SP, 'files.txt')
open(lst, 'w').write('\n'.join(files) + '\n')
tok = json.loads(subprocess.run(['tokei', '--output', 'json', '--files'] + files, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                check=True).stdout)
code = {}
for r in tok['Rust']['reports']:
    n = r['name'].replace('\\', '/')
    n = n[2:] if n.startswith('./') else n
    code[n] = r['stats']['code']
over = sorted([(f, v) for f, v in code.items() if v > 800], key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))

rca = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=SP, prefix='rca-')
fns = []
for f in files:
    o = subprocess.run(['rust-code-analysis-cli', '-m', '-O', 'json', '-p', f], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if o.returncode != 0 or not o.stdout.strip():
        continue
    j = json.loads(o.stdout)

    def walk(s):
        if s['kind'] == 'function':
            fns.append({'fn': s['name'], 'file': f, 'line': s['start_line'],
                        'cog': s['metrics']['cognitive']['sum'], 'cyc': s['metrics']['cyclomatic']['sum']})
        for c in s.get('spaces', []):
            walk(c)
    walk(j)
oc = sorted([x for x in fns if x['cog'] > 15], key=lambda x: (-x['cog'], x['file'], x['line']))
res = {'head': head, 'upstream_main': upsha, 'files': len(files), 'tokei_files': len(code),
       'file_max': max(code.values()), 'over_800': len(over),
       'over_800_rows': [{'file': f, 'code': v, 'class': cls(f)} for f, v in over],
       'functions': len(fns), 'over_ceiling': len(oc),
       'over_ceiling_rows': [{'fn': x['fn'], 'at': f"{x['file']}:{x['line']}", 'cog': x['cog'], 'class': cls(x['file'])}
                             for x in oc]}
json.dump(res, open(os.path.join(SP, 'measure-head.json'), 'w'), indent=1)
print('head', head[:9], 'upstream/main', upsha[:9], '· files', len(files), 'tokei', len(code), '· functions', len(fns))
print('file_max', res['file_max'], '· over_800', len(over), dict(collections.Counter(cls(f) for f, _ in over)))
for f, v in over:
    print(f'  {v:5d} {cls(f):8s} {f}')
print('over_ceiling', len(oc), dict(collections.Counter(x['class'] for x in res['over_ceiling_rows'])))
for x in res['over_ceiling_rows']:
    if x['class'] == 'ours':
        print(f"  {x['cog']:6.1f} ours     {x['fn']} {x['at']}")
by = collections.Counter(x['at'].split(':')[0] for x in res['over_ceiling_rows'] if x['class'] == 'upstream')
print(' upstream by file', by.most_common())

body:
"""The chunk's preservation guard: what changed since BASE stays inside the chunk's files.

usage: python3 scope_guard.py BASE
Reads the tracked files changed against BASE (`git diff --name-only BASE`) and the untracked ones not ignored
(`git ls-files -o --exclude-standard`). Paths under `.andromeda/`, `.claude/` and `escher-0.4.0/` (the run's
bookkeeping and the route's stamp) are set aside. Every other path must be one of the chunk's twelve files, and none may stand in upstream/main at 547d7514b (the
class-2 boundary: no upstream-authored file is edited).
Prints each path outside the list and an upstream-authored path touched, then `scope guard: PASS` or `FAIL`.
"""
import subprocess, sys

ALLOWED = {
    'packages/escher-driver/src/json_tests.rs', 'packages/escher-driver/src/json_tests/fixtures.rs',
    'packages/escher-driver/src/command.rs', 'packages/escher-driver/src/command/key.rs',
    'packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs', 'packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot_tests.rs',
    'packages/escher-driver/src/cli.rs', 'packages/escher-driver/src/mcp.rs',
    'tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_runtime_probe.rs', 'tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_graph.rs',
    'tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_actions.rs', 'tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_accessibility_ids.rs',
}


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.split('\n')


base = sys.argv[1]
changed = {p for p in git('diff', '--name-only', base) + git('ls-files', '-o', '--exclude-standard') if p}
changed = {p for p in changed if not p.startswith(('.andromeda/', '.claude/', 'escher-0.4.0/'))}
upstream = set(git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', '547d7514ba2adb357d41d5e4655a63ddd5cdc5ec'))
outside = sorted(changed - ALLOWED)
touched_upstream = sorted(changed & upstream)
for p in outside:
    print(f'outside the chunk: {p}')
for p in touched_upstream:
    print(f'upstream-authored touched: {p}')
print(f'changed {len(changed)} · outside {len(outside)} · upstream-authored {len(touched_upstream)}')
print('scope guard: PASS' if not outside and not touched_upstream else 'scope guard: FAIL')

title: evidence/test_paths.py
body:
"""The chunk's test-path guard: every test the workspace lists keeps its path.

usage: python3 test_paths.py record FILE   — writes the sorted list to FILE
       python3 test_paths.py check FILE    — compares the tree's list with FILE
The list is `cargo test --workspace --locked -- --list` (stdout and stderr merged), each `{path}: test` line
keyed by the binary of the `Running {source} ({binary})` line above it, its hash cut: `{source} {path}`.
`check` prints each path gone and each path new, then `test paths: PASS` (the same set) or `test paths: FAIL`.
"""
import re, subprocess, sys

mode, path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
out = subprocess.run(['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--locked', '--', '--list'], stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                     stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
if out.returncode != 0:
    print(out.stdout[-4000:])
    print('test paths: FAIL — the listing did not run')
    sys.exit(1)
source = None
paths = set()
for line in out.stdout.splitlines():
    m = re.match(r'\s*Running .*\((.+)\)\s*$', line)
    if m:
        source = re.sub(r'-[0-9a-f]{16}$', '', m.group(1).rsplit('/', 1)[-1])
        continue
    m = re.match(r'\s*Doc-tests\s+(\S+)', line)
    if m:
        source = 'doc:' + m.group(1)
        continue
    m = re.match(r'^(.+): test$', line)
    if m and source:
        paths.add(f'{source} {m.group(1)}')
listed = sorted(paths)
if mode == 'record':
    open(path, 'w').write('\n'.join(listed) + '\n')
    print(f'recorded {len(listed)} test paths')
    sys.exit(0)
base = {l for l in open(path).read().splitlines() if l}
gone, new = sorted(base - paths), sorted(paths - base)
for p in gone:
    print(f'gone: {p}')
for p in new:
    print(f'new: {p}')
print(f'listed {len(paths)} · base {len(base)} · gone {len(gone)} · new {len(new)}')
print('test paths: PASS' if not gone and not new else 'test paths: FAIL')
sys.exit(0 if not gone and not new else 1)
